Original Analysis:
```{r}
#load('~/Desktop/Pstat 197A/module1-biomarker-main-team13/data/biomarker-clean.RData')

test_fn <- function(.df){
  t_test(.df, 
         formula = level ~ group,
         order = c('ASD', 'TD'),
         alternative = 'two-sided',
         var.equal = F)
}

ttests_out <- biomarker_clean %>%
  select(-ados) %>%
  pivot_longer(-group, 
               names_to = 'protein', 
               values_to = 'level') %>%
  nest(data = c(level, group)) %>% 
  mutate(ttest = map(data, test_fn)) %>%
  unnest(ttest) %>%
  arrange(p_value) %>%
  mutate(m = n(),
         hm = log(m) + 1/(2*m) - digamma(1),
         rank = row_number(),
         p.adj = m*hm*p_value/rank)

proteins_s1 <- ttests_out %>%
  slice_min(p.adj, n = 10) %>%
  pull(protein)

predictors <- biomarker_clean %>%
  select(-c(group, ados))

response <- biomarker_clean %>% pull(group) %>% factor()

set.seed(101422)
rf_out <- randomForest(x = predictors, 
                       y = response, 
                       ntree = 1000, 
                       importance = T)

proteins_s2 <- rf_out$importance %>% 
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(protein = rownames(rf_out$importance)) %>%
  slice_max(MeanDecreaseGini, n = 10) %>%
  pull(protein)


proteins_sstar <- intersect(proteins_s1, proteins_s2)

biomarker_sstar <- biomarker_clean %>%
  select(group, any_of(proteins_sstar)) %>%
  mutate(class = (group == 'ASD')) %>%
  select(-group)

set.seed(101422)
biomarker_split <- biomarker_sstar %>%
  initial_split(prop = 0.8)

fit <- glm(class ~ ., 
           data = training(biomarker_split), 
           family = 'binomial')

class_metrics <- metric_set(sensitivity, 
                            specificity, 
                            accuracy,
                            roc_auc)

og_results <- testing(biomarker_split) %>%
  add_predictions(fit, type = 'response') %>%
  mutate(class = factor(class),
    predicted_class = factor(pred > 0.5)
  ) %>%
  class_metrics(estimate = predicted_class,
                truth = class, pred,
                event_level = 'second'
  )

og_results
```
Original Results:

sensitivity: 0.9375000		
specificity: 0.7333333		
accuracy: 0.8387097		
roc_auc: 0.8958333	


80-20 Train/Test Split:
```{r}
set.seed(197)

biomarker_split <- initial_split(
  biomarker_clean,
  prop = 0.8,
  strata = group
)

biomarker_train <- training(biomarker_split)
biomarker_test  <- testing(biomarker_split)

# Welch's t-test on training
ttests_train <- biomarker_train %>%
  select(-ados) %>%
  pivot_longer(-group, 
               names_to = 'protein', 
               values_to = 'level') %>%
  nest(data = c(level, group)) %>% 
  mutate(ttest = map(data, test_fn)) %>%
  unnest(ttest) %>%
  arrange(p_value) %>%
  mutate(m = n(),
         hm = log(m) + 1/(2*m) - digamma(1),
         rank = row_number(),
         raw_adj = m*hm*p_value/rank,
         p.adj = pmin(1, rev(cummin(rev(raw_adj)))))

# select top 25 proteins
proteins_s1 <- ttests_train %>%
  slice_min(p.adj, n = 25, with_ties = F) %>%
  pull(protein)

# random forest on training by adjusted p-value
predictors <- biomarker_train %>%
  select(-c(group, ados))

response <- biomarker_train %>% pull(group) %>% factor()

set.seed(101422)
rf_train <- randomForest(x = predictors, 
                       y = response, 
                       ntree = 1000, 
                       importance = T)

rf_train$confusion

# select top 25 by random forest
proteins_s2 <- rf_train$importance %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "protein") %>%
  slice_max(
    MeanDecreaseGini, 
    n = 25,
    with_ties = F) %>%
  pull(protein)

# intersection for comparison
proteins_sstar <- intersect(proteins_s1, proteins_s2)

sstar <- function(df) {df %>%
  select(group, any_of(proteins_sstar)) %>%
  mutate(class = (group == 'ASD')) %>%
  select(-group)}

training_sstar <- sstar(biomarker_train)
testing_sstar <- sstar(biomarker_test)

fit <- glm(class ~ ., 
           data = training_sstar, 
           family = 'binomial')

class_results <- metric_set(sensitivity, 
                            specificity, 
                            accuracy,
                            roc_auc)


train_results <- testing_sstar %>%
  add_predictions(fit, type = 'response') %>%
  mutate(class = factor(class),
    predicted_class = factor(pred > 0.5)
  ) %>%
  class_metrics(estimate = predicted_class,
                truth = class, pred,
                event_level = 'second'
  )

print(train_results)

data.frame(metric = og_results$.metric, 
           diff =  train_results$.estimate - og_results$.estimate)

# When we carry out the entire selection procedure on a training partition
# Every estimated value is significantly lower than our initial findings
# The smallest metric difference, specificity, is a decrease of approximately .09
# The largest metric decrease, sensitivity, is by approximately 0.33
# Overall, our new model performs worst than our original analysis
# However, it is important to note that our original analysis may have overfitted
# Note that our diff column is (new - old)
```
Train/Test Split Results:
sensitivity: 0.875
specificity: 0.75
accuracy: 0.812
roc_auc: 0.871

Fuzzy Intersection:
```{r}
set.seed(101422)

#Assigning protein membership score by min-max normalization

# Rank all proteins by Random Forest importance
rf_membership <- rf_train$importance %>%
  as_tibble(rownames = "protein") %>%
  mutate(
    rf_rank = rank(-MeanDecreaseGini),
    mu_rf = 1 - (rf_rank - 1) / (n() - 1)
  ) %>%
  select(protein, rf_rank, mu_rf)

# Rank all proteins by adjusted t-test p-value
t_membership <- ttests_train %>%
  mutate(
    t_rank = rank(p.adj),
    mu_t = 1 - (t_rank - 1) / (n() - 1)
  ) %>%
  select(protein, t_rank, mu_t)

# Combine memberships using the minimum operator
fuzzy_proteins <- inner_join(
  rf_membership, 
  t_membership,
  by = "protein"
) %>%
  mutate(
    mu_fuzzy = pmin(mu_rf, mu_t)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mu_fuzzy))

# Select the top 25 proteins with the highest fuzzy memberships
proteins_fuzzy <- fuzzy_proteins %>%
  slice_max(
    mu_fuzzy, 
    n = 25, 
    with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  pull(protein)

fuzzy_proteins %>%
  filter(protein %in% proteins_fuzzy) %>%
  arrange(desc(mu_fuzzy))
```

```{r}
# compare fuzzy selection
setdiff(proteins_fuzzy, proteins_sstar)
setdiff(proteins_sstar, proteins_fuzzy)
```
The top proteins with the highest fuzzy memberships are "Cadherin-5", "MIA", "MMP-2", "RET", and "TSP4".


Logistic Regression
```{r}
biomarker_fuzzy_train <- biomarker_train %>%
  select(group, all_of(proteins_fuzzy)) %>%
  mutate(
    class = factor(
      group == "ASD",
      levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-group)

biomarker_fuzzy_test <- biomarker_test %>%
  select(group, all_of(proteins_fuzzy)) %>%
  mutate(
    class = factor(
      group == "ASD",
      levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-group)

# Fit using training data
fit_fuzzy <- glm(
  class ~ .,
  data = biomarker_fuzzy_train,
  family = "binomial"
)

# Evaluate only on held-out test data
fuzzy_predictions <- biomarker_fuzzy_test %>%
  mutate(
    pred = predict(
      fit_fuzzy,
      newdata = biomarker_fuzzy_test,
      type = "response"
    ),
    predicted_class = factor(
      pred > 0.5,
      levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)
    )
  )

class_results <- metric_set(
  sensitivity,
  specificity,
  accuracy
)(
  fuzzy_predictions,
  truth = class,
  estimate = predicted_class,
  event_level = "second"
)

auc_result <- roc_auc(
  fuzzy_predictions,
  truth = class,
  pred,
  event_level = "second"
)

fuzzy_results <- bind_rows(class_results, auc_result)

print(fuzzy_results)

# Compare with original results
data.frame(
  metric = og_results$.metric,
  diff = fuzzy_results$.estimate[
    match(og_results$.metric, fuzzy_results$.metric)
  ] - og_results$.estimate
)

#Through fuzzy intersection, we achieved a raw overall improvement
#Specificity (0.2) and auc (0.05), slight decrease in sensitivity (-0.19)
#Applied min-max normalization to calculate membership of rf and t-test, which we took the pmin between the two membership scores.
#Should account for different methods in calculating membership scores.
```
